questions.title: How short can a phone number be and still count as valid?
questions.question: If a merchant types a country code followed by only a few digits (for example "+1 415"), should we accept it and store it in the standard format, or treat it as failing the check and save it exactly as typed?

options.label: Too short: save it exactly as typed
options.clarification: A number passes the check only if it has at least 7 digits (country code included, up to 15); shorter numbers fail the check and are saved exactly as the merchant typed them.

options.label: Accept it: store it in the standard format
options.clarification: Any number with a country code and at least 2 digits in total (up to 15) passes the check and is stored in the standard format, e.g. "+1 415" is stored as "+1415".
